tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Answer "do you serve <city or ZIP>?" for ORS Clean's South Bay / Silicon Valley / Central Coast area. Not required before request_quote, which checks the service area itself. Returns the nearest served city when the answer is no.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Request an ORS Clean quote for gutter cleaning, gutter guards & minor repair, pressure washing, roof cleaning, solar panel cleaning, house wash + windows, window cleaning, fence/deck staining, or commercial/HOA work in Gilroy, Morgan Hill, San Jose, Hollister, Watsonville, Salinas, Campbell, Los Gat

tools.name: about_ors_clean
tools.description: Answer "who is ORS Clean / are they legit / insured / licensed / what do they do / where do they work / tell me about ORS Clean" questions. Returns ORS Clean's business license, insurance, the services it offers, the cities it serves, its reviews, and contact info. For WHEN ORS Clean is available /

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Returns ORS Clean's open morning (8–12) and afternoon (12–4) service windows for the next two weeks in Gilroy, Morgan Hill, San Jose, Hollister, Watsonville, Salinas, Campbell, Los Gatos, Saratoga, Santa Clara, Cupertino, Milpitas and the surrounding South Bay / Silicon Valley / Central Coast area.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_quote, about_ors_clean · Private data: about_ors_clean · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_quote, about_ors_clean · Private data: about_ors_clean · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "request_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
